scripts.package:prepare: pnpm build && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:companion && pnpm build:updater && pnpm build:android-tools && pnpm build:cloudflared && pnpm build:browser && pnpm build:duckdb
scripts.package:mac: export OPENMAUSBOT_CUA_ARCHES=arm64 OPENMAUSBOT_CUA_ARCHES_PARTIAL=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false DEXBOT_CODESIGN_IDENTITY="DEX BOT Development" && pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:speech && pnpm build:cua && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:cua:win && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:cua:linux && electron-builder --config.productName=LunaBot --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:arch: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:cua:linux && electron-builder --config.productName=LunaBot --linux pacman --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:offline: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:cua:linux:offline && electron-builder --config.productName=LunaBot --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:cua:linux && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never
